_comment: Manual corrections for the GA news hub, applied by generate_ga_news.py. This is an editorial control surface for a public aggregator.

_howto._add: Array of hand-curated articles { title, url, source, publishedAt (ISO), snippet } ingested through the same gates as feed items (dedupe by url, entity tagging, topics, 45-day window). Use for an article a feed missed or dropped.
_howto._suppress: Array of item ids (12-char sha1 prefix from ga-news.json) OR url substrings to drop entirely (spam, off-topic, or a source's non-news item).
_howto.per-item patch: A top-level key = an item id; value = { entityIds: [...], topics: [...] } to REPLACE the auto-detected tags on that item (e.g. fix a missed or wrong entity match).

_add.title: Bottoms, Jackson debate healthcare, data centers in sole scheduled forum
_add.snippet: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms and Republican Rick Jackson clashed Tuesday night over healthcare, crime, data centers and election security in a town hall-style debate at the Atlanta News First studio.
